explanation: The condition requires Sam Okonjo to send a text message confirming the appointment, but no event shows that the message was sent and observed by someone; e24 and e31 are not observed, and e44 only shows Sam seeing a sent message, not the sending itself.
Sam Okonjo sent a text message confirming the appointment (e24, e31) and observed it in his sent messages (e44) before the deadline.
